en: Job 37

p.src: 1  “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.

en: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.
u.src: 1  “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.

p.src: 2  Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.

en: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.
u.src: 2  Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.

p.src: 3  He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.

en: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.
u.src: 3  He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.

p.src: 4  After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.

en: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.
u.src: 4  After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.

p.src: 5  God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.

en: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.
u.src: 5  God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.

p.src: 6  For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.

en: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.
u.src: 6  For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.

p.src: 7  He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.

en: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.
u.src: 7  He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.

p.src: 8  Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.

en: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.
u.src: 8  Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.

p.src: 9  Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.

en: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.
u.src: 9  Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.

p.src: 10  By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.

en: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.
u.src: 10  By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.

p.src: 11  Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.

en: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.
u.src: 11  Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.

p.src: 12  It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,

en: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,
u.src: 12  It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,

p.src: 13  whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.

en: whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.
u.src: 13  whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.

p.src: 14  “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

en: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
u.src: 14  “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

p.src: 15  Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?

en: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?
u.src: 15  Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?

p.src: 16  Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?

en: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?
u.src: 16  Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?

p.src: 17  You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?

en: You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?
u.src: 17  You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?

p.src: 18  Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?

en: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?
u.src: 18  Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?

p.src: 19  Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.

en: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.
u.src: 19  Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.

p.src: 20  Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

en: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?
u.src: 20  Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

p.src: 21  Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.

en: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.
u.src: 21  Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.

p.src: 22  Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.

en: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.
u.src: 22  Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.

p.src: 23  We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.

en: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.
u.src: 23  We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.

p.src: 24  Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”

en: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”
u.src: 24  Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”
